I took the delivered app for a spin, and it does what we agreed. I pasted a link and it pulled in the page title automatically while leaving everything editable; I saved a bookmark and it showed up with its title, description, tags, and date; it caught a duplicate when I tried saving the same link twice and pointed me to the existing one; search and tag filtering both narrowed things down correctly; editing updated the saved values; and deleting asked for confirmation and then removed it cleanly. My saves stuck around rather than vanishing, and the empty state is clear about how to start.

This is exactly the bookmark manager I was hoping for. I'm happy to accept it.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
